recordingPrompt: Assess this codebase. Say which components in it are near-copies of each other, which named style blocks declare the same thing under different names, and which utility-class bundles are repeated often enough to be a component nobody extracted. Score every answer.

cases.note: three class words in common out of four, on the same tag — the same component, one variant class apart
identical class words cannot reach the clone band on their own, because the tag is a quarter of the score
nothing in common but being elements — reported would mean every pair in a codebase is reported
the classic: a card and a panel declaring exactly the same thing
and they are read out of a plain `.js` file, because that is where CSS-in-JS lives
half the same is worth reporting quietly and never worth a merge suggestion

long enough to be a bundle, not repeated often enough to be one — the uses threshold, doing its job
